name: apex-migration
description: Migrate NuGet PowerShell E2E tests to C# Apex tests or unit tests. Use this skill whenever the user asks to migrate, convert, or port a PowerShell end-to-end test from test/EndToEnd/tests/ to an Apex test in test/NuGet.Tests.Apex/ or to a unit test in test/NuGet.Clients.Tests/NuGetConsole.Host.PowerShell.Test/. Also trigger when the user mentions "Apex test", "migrate PS test", "E2E test migration", "PMC test", "cmdlet unit test", "PowerShell unit test", or references any PowerShell test function like Install-PackageTest or Update-PackageTest and wants it rewritten in C#. Even if the user just says "migrate this test" while looking at a PS E2E file, use this skill. Also trigger whenever the user wants to write a new Apex test or a new PMC cmdlet unit test.
